edges.reason: Constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender(), so msg.sender controls ownership and every onlyOwner function.
_transfer requires _msgSender() to equal the router or the pair when cooldown is active, tying caller identity to transfer legitimacy.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _teamAddress.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _teamAddress.
cooldown[to] is compared with and written from block.timestamp, making transfer eligibility timestamp dependent.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer() forwards to _transfer with _msgSender().
transferFrom() forwards to _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
_transfer delegates the accounting work to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard after optionally zeroing fees.
_transferStandard credits the team share through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies reflection fees through _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam increases _rOwned for the contract address.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_transfer performs the token swap before the sender/recipient reflection balances are updated.
_transfer sends ETH out to team/marketing inside the transfer flow.
swapTokensForEth hands control to the external router contract.
sendETHToFee forwards ETH with transfer(), which may execute recipient code.
openTrading calls the external router with ETH value.
openTrading calls the external factory to create the pair.
openTrading approves the pair for the maximum uint256 allowance.
openTrading stores the mainnet router in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
manualswap invokes the swap routine with the full contract token balance.
manualsend invokes ETH payout to team and marketing addresses.
uniswapV2Router is the external contract targeted by the swap call.
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswapV2Pair address to branch fee and swap logic.
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to].
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping.
_taxFee is read by _getValues when computing fees.
_teamFee is read by _getValues when computing the team share.
_getValues supplies the amount tuple consumed by _transferStandard.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side amounts.
balanceOf converts reflections with tokenFromReflection.
_maxTxAmount is derived from _tTotal through multiplication and division.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount from _tTotal with mul/div.
_getRate divides the reflection supply derived from _rTotal.
balanceOf reads the caller's _rOwned balance.
_teamAddress receives half of the ETH moved by sendETHToFee.
_marketingFunds receives half of the ETH moved by sendETHToFee.
The inSwap flag, set by lockTheSwap, gates the external swap inside _transfer.
The external router swap transfers ETH back to the contract, re-entering the receive() fallback mid-transfer.
The constructor establishes the initial owner.
renounceOwnership clears _owner and permanently disables privileged functions.
owner() returns the stored _owner used in the onlyOwner modifier.
setBots writes the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot removes an entry from the bots blacklist mapping.
approve() delegates to _approve.
swapTokensForEth grants the router an allowance before swapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to derive takeFee.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown and router-only restrictions in _transfer.
_transfer enforces require(amount <= _maxTxAmount).
The from parameter drives all address checks in _transfer.
The to parameter drives recipient checks and cooldown writes in _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount and forwarded.
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
takeFee selects removeAllFee/restoreAllFee around _tokenTransfer.
tokenAmount is the input for the router swap call.
The path array is supplied to the external swap call.
The amount parameter is split and transferred to the fee addresses.
Each entry of bots_ is written into the blacklist mapping.
maxTxPercent scales _tTotal when updating _maxTxAmount.
addr1 is stored into _teamAddress by the constructor.
addr2 is stored into _marketingFunds by the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to parameterize _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The to parameter only exists to parameterize _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The amount parameter is transient transfer input bound to _transfer.
The local balance is immediately consumed by the swap call and can be folded into it.
The local ETH balance is immediately forwarded to sendETHToFee.
takeFee is a temporary branch flag whose only consumer is _tokenTransfer.
tokenAmount is a temporary argument of the swap routine.
The path array exists only to feed the external swap call.
The ETH amount is transient input split by sendETHToFee.
The bots_ array is only iterated by setBots to populate the blacklist.
maxTxPercent is a transient scaling argument of setMaxTxPercent.
addr1 is consumed only by the constructor to initialize _teamAddress.
addr2 is consumed only by the constructor to initialize _marketingFunds.
